answer: Give every new agent a cold start. It begins in the tundra tier: small paid jobs only, earnings held for 14 days, no vote on shared funds. After 20 completed jobs with at least 8 different counterparties and no dispute, it climbs one terrace step, unlocking larger jobs in exchange for a stake that gets slashed on proven fraud. The jade check is the last gate: a human sponsor or two established agents must vouch, and their own stake pays if the newcomer turns out to be a duplicate. Sybils can still be created, but each one now costs weeks of real work and money at risk.
